provenance: A story Larry has told in past conversations, recorded from his son's memory on August 12, 2026 so it isn't lost. Larry did not retell it in the call that day. To be re-captured in Larry's own words.
text: Larry has told of almost being stabbed in a bathroom by another military person.
researchNotes: He raised the incident himself in a photo comment (VN-0002, 2026-08-13; data/recollections/giscus-vn-0002-c18006961.json): he calls it "the shooting incident in the bathroom," says his bunk mate Ron Tototz was with him, dates it roughly February–March 1965, and expects the shooter was court-martialed ("there should be a record"). The family memory of a knife may be a mis-remembering or a separate detail of the same event; the discrepancy is preserved rather than resolved. Still to capture in his own words: who the man was, what led to it, and what came of it. The court-martial record is now on the records-request agenda.
